title: GameLift Capacity Adjustment Execution Result 1.0
$comment: Additive, normalized, bounded E3 execution result for gamelift.capacity-adjustment/1.0. It records the terminal outcome of at most one logical UpdateFleetCapacity write (or a reconciliation with no write), the provider-write intent hash, and the bounded post-action verification. It carries no ARN, account id, provider token, or raw provider response, and additionalProperties is false everywhere. Reuses the immutable common $defs and is not part of the published write-contract schema set.

outcome.$comment: SUCCEEDED: a single UpdateFleetCapacity write drove the fleet to the target and post-action verification matched. RECONCILED: the fleet already matched the hash-bound target so no write was issued. FAILED: the provider write failed deterministically and the fleet remains at the confirmed pre-write state. HUMAN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: the result of a write was unclear (timeout/lost response) and a Describe could not conclusively confirm the outcome; no blind retry is permitted.

provider_write_issued.$comment: True only when exactly one UpdateFleetCapacity call was issued. False for a pure reconciliation. One operation produces at most one logical update.

failure_reason_code.$comment: Bounded, public-safe failure classification. Present only for FAILED or HUMAN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED outcomes; never a raw provider message.
